title: Home of the Whopper®
slide_intent: Keep a familiar claim in a recognizable configuration so a reader immediately connects the phrase with its signature product.
strategic_value: The dominant Whopper name can strengthen the relationship between Burger King’s place claim and its product equity.
demonstration: Two pale lockups on brown stack Home of the at left of a much larger Whopper, comparing registered and restaurant-signage-only versions.
practical_value: Use the supplied phrase arrangement for signage, except when the wording occurs inside a paragraph.

content_islands.name: Claim-lockup guidance
content_islands.spec: Place the fixed-configuration rule and in-store-signage example at left.

content_islands.name: Registered claim
content_islands.spec: Place the registered lockup in the upper right with the small words stacked alongside Whopper.

content_islands.name: Signage claim
content_islands.spec: Repeat the lockup below without registration and retain its signage-only caption.

reference_purposes.Expression: The subordinate stacked words give Whopper the largest visual weight.
reference_purposes.Application: The source names in-store signage as an example application.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use the fixed configuration except inside paragraph copy; consult BKC marketing/legal on signage trademark treatment.

ingredient.name: Home of the Whopper lockup
ingredient.role: Tie a place claim to the recognizable product name.
ingredient.application: Use the supplied stacked phrase beside the larger Whopper wordmark.
ingredient.scope: Historical guide; paragraph copy is an exception and signage registration requires consultation.
